pass_rule: PASS if the half-patch statistic is 0 +/- 38.2 mK (2 sigma over the two analysed laps at the registered 27 mK floor, 8.3% of E62-WE42's prediction) whichever way the patch is cut, the gradient has no preferred direction, and the monopole is null. This block is the empirical bound for the whole set, covering what a permutation null cannot reach: FFC steps, non-linear field drift, and the camera's radial warm-up. If it shows a dipole, every number in the swap blocks is suspect and the session's conclusion is about the instrument, not the chip -- and E62-NULLAA, which runs BEFORE it, separates 'the instrument' from 'the die map'. Raising this block to cycles 5 (four analysed laps, the quadratically balanced 8-phase order, a 27 mK bound) is the first item in the slack queue; at two analysed laps it carries the same residual quadratic leak as every other two-lap block, which is why E62-NULLAA is reduced twice (see conventions.sign_orders.note).
